transcript.text: There's six ways to get the same
customer to pay you more money. First is
obviously to increase price. So, if a
fulfillment stays the same, then every
dollar of price increase drops straight
to the bottom line, which is good.
Number two is you can decrease costs.
So, you decrease the cost of whatever it
takes you to fulfill your product or
service. Number three is you increase
purchase frequency. Getting somebody to
buy your product or service more times.
Number four is upselling. Getting
somebody to buy a bigger or better or
premium version of whatever they just
bought. Number five is cross-sell.
Getting somebody to buy an additional or
complimentary product or service in
addition to their original purchase.
Number six is a down-sell. So, you sell
a smaller, less expensive, less premium
version of your main thing.
